data_sources.notes: botanical_name inferred from common_name by Ollama - no source had one; not sourced from an external database, verify before trusting

growth_habit='climbing' inferred by Ollama (no Trefle growth_habit data (no cached match or null field)); reasoning: Pole beans are known for their vining habit and require a trellis or support to grow upward.
family/genus backfilled from Wikipedia/Wikidata taxonomy for genus 'Phaseolus'
life_cycle='annual' inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Pole beans are typically grown as annuals in temperate climates like Belgium, as they complete their life cycle within one growing season.
edible_parts=['pods'] inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Pole beans are typically eaten as pods when they are immature and tender.

is_edible corrected from false to true (GitHub issue #165): edible_parts=['pods'] was already populated, a direct contradiction with is_edible=false, and no is_toxic flag or toxicity_notes explained the discrepancy - a full-dataset audit found this affecting 120 plants (grown from an earlier 25-plant spot-check once backlog #133's edible_parts backfill widened coverage), all of them unambiguous real food/herb/fruit crops.
